meta.title: Programming mode preset
meta.description: Adds a 编程模式 agent mode: the standard full coding agent plus Superpowers engineering discipline (skills-first, design, plans, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion, code review, Chinese documentation, Ponytail code-volume restraint) and the bundled Superpowers/ponytail skill library. Enable the bundle, then start a new session and pick 编程模式.
